[@m2d/cache](../index.mdx) / simpleCleanup

# Function: simpleCleanup()

> **simpleCleanup**(`maxAgeMinutes`, `namespace`): `Promise`\<`void`\>

Defined in: [cache.ts:349](https://github.com/md2docx/md2docx/blob/main/packages/cache/src/cache.ts#L349)

Deletes stale cache entries from IndexedDB based on age and namespace.

- Only entries with matching `namespace` are considered
- Entries older than `maxAgeMinutes` (based on `last-accessed` field) are deleted

Requirements for each entry:
- `namespace: string` set in `createPersistentCache`
- `last-accessed: number` is automatically set by `writeToCache`

## Parameters

### maxAgeMinutes

`number`

Age threshold in minutes; entries older than this will be removed

### namespace

`string`

Namespace tag to limit cleanup scope

## Returns

`Promise`\<`void`\>
